item.title: Full professor: 1 full professor position - Article 18, paragraph 4ter of Law 240/2010 - MATH-01/B - DMI (Univ. PALERMO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-16 12:00
Institution: Univ. PALERMO, Palermo
Field: Mathematics and computer science / 01/MATH-01 Logica matematica, didattica e storia della matematica

The University of Palermo calls a selection procedure to cover 1 position as university full professor of Mathematics Education and History of Mathematics, pursuant to art. 18, paragraph 4-ter, of Law 240/2010, at the Department of Mathematics and Computer Science.
